notes.title: 2025/08/30 Update Log v0.005
notes.notes: [h1]Improvements[/h1][list][*][p]Updated player animations to make holding milk tea cups look more natural.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to cancel from the settlement screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a sound effect when receiving money after giving recyclables to Sucola.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased daily gameplay time limit.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a warning when trying to serve drinks with insufficient water.[/p][/*][*][p]Syrup can no longer be added after reaching the normal sugar level.[/p][/*][*][p]Doubled the speed of Fresh Orange Juice making.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the UI for syrup, ice, and cup size display on the cup.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where some NPCs' clothing appeared missing on clients.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where, when aiming at a cup, if another player changed the cup’s properties, the UI would update incorrectly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players couldn’t see other players’ ping in the settlement screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where hand animations did not reset after giving gifts to NPCs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players couldn’t place items in a cup if it was already full, and this wasn’t reflected to all players.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the UI for a cup on the left side of the rack persisted even after placing a cup.[/p][/*][*][p]Possibly fixed an issue where placing cups into the sink at the same time could cause one to disappear.[/p][/*][*][p]Possibly fixed an issue where placing lemons onto the cutting board simultaneously could cause a lemon to vanish.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where rotten items had no effect on customers.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where rotten items would lose their rotten state when switching containers.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Double Pearl Milk Tea could not be unlocked.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h1] v0.04 Fixes[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Lemon Green Tea could not be crafted.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several issues related to spoilage logic.[/p][/*][*][p]Pearls no longer spoil.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where placing green tea in a pot after clearing it still showed as spoiled.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in multiplayer where clients could not discard trash from their hands.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where, after viewing the sales analysis on the settlement screen, the next day could not be exited.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect values for large syrup amounts.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a container that held one type of solution could not hold another type.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where feeding a kitten once would instantly unlock a new recipe.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a freeze that could occur when the second player joined in multiplayer.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the cashier desk could sometimes disappear.[/p][/*][/list]
